Render does not apply redirect or rewrite rules to a path if a resource exists at that path.
The header path must be a relative path without the domain. It will be matched with all custom domains attached to your site.
You can apply your own custom domains to Render web services and static sites . Services with a custom domain also keep their onrender.com subdomain.
